integrity: Analytical proof included with independently coded finite comparisons. No independent mathematics audit or certification has been undertaken.
mathematical_scope: The uniform-direction half-widths of the regular icosahedron and regular dodecahedron, each normalized to circumradius one, have explicit full CDFs and strict stochastic order on their shared interior support.
scientific_limitations: The order concerns this specific centrally symmetric dual pair under equal circumradii. The support-cell formula is a specialization of standard solid-angle methods, and a published general normal-fan density theorem already supplies broad machinery. Historical priority beyond the inspected sources is uncertain. Finite randomized tests do not constitute proof.
title: Complete width laws and stochastic ordering for the dual golden Platonic solids
